book.name: 2 Kolinita
book.title: 2 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta heluwena Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Moisa, tutaina mwalo yanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega sahena yaboꞌeboꞌenegomi ma yaheheliyegomi ta debamwadina yaꞌebwaꞌebwaegomi ꞌiyamiuina ꞌina mumuga galana weyahina. Beno namo ꞌimi leta yaleleyawa.
Coinega yanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega ꞌeguma ꞌigu gwaeyega yaꞌabihenuwa galegomiya, ꞌoimiyega taiya ꞌiꞌabihe yaliyayegau?

Ma ꞌimi letaina yaleleyawa maꞌigu ꞌatemuya ma maꞌigu nuwagala ma ꞌigu dou, ma ꞌoinega tutaina ꞌeguma yaboꞌenegomi waꞌabihe yaliyayegau, ma sahena yanuwanuwagala, ma hesi mabwaiyami yahemisaegomiya ma yanuwatuhu yahiya ꞌabehega taugu ꞌigu yaliyayega ꞌomi wete wayaliyaya. Coinega ꞌimi letaina yaleleyawa, geya ꞌabehega yaꞌabihe nuwa galegomi ma hesi ꞌigu helau madou hedade ꞌoimiya wasanasanapu.
Ma ꞌiyamiu galanaina ꞌiꞌabihenuwa galegauwa tupwana tuwa, ma hesi ꞌomi nuwagala madouna ꞌiꞌebwaegomiya, ma geya nuwagu ma yaheliye,
weyahina galana ꞌana maisa ꞌilobeya mabwaiyami ꞌoimiyega, tuwa sowasowahina.
Sahena mwau madou hedade talagulagu ꞌoina, ꞌoinega ꞌoimiya yaꞌahwanoi ma ꞌina puiina wanuwasam ma waꞌabihe yaliyaya hila ma wete baꞌidamiu waheꞌiyaꞌiyagu hila.
Bewa weyahina ꞌimi leta yaleleyawa ma ꞌabehega yatohogemi, nuwana loina mabwaiyana wamuliyedi, bo geya.
Ceguma taiya ꞌina pui wanuwasam taugu wete yanuwasam, ma toꞌaha taugu yanuwasamuya beno ꞌomi ꞌimi bwebweꞌana weyahina, Keliso matana,
ꞌamuge ma Seitani ꞌihewaiwai ꞌoida, weyahina ꞌina nuwatuhu galana tasanapu pwaiya.
Mwalo yatauya Tilowasi, Keliso tetelina sabi lohatotoina, ma Yehoba ꞌeda bwebweꞌana ꞌisoꞌeya, ꞌigu lohatotoina weyahina,
ma hesi yanuwatuhuya madouna weyahina tasigu Taito geya yaloba. Coinega meTilowasi yaꞌebesinediya ma yatauya Masidoniya.

Coinega Yehoba ꞌoina yaloyauwedo, weyahina Keliso ꞌina waiwaiyega tuta baibaiwana ꞌiꞌabiꞌabi hewaiwaiyemai ma ꞌima paihowega Keliso ꞌana sanapu tupwa mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya ꞌidabalala gide hoya mahaina ꞌausala hedade ꞌidabalala ma tomota sinisoniso,
beno Keliso ꞌina paihowa Yehoba ꞌoina, ta weyahina ꞌalolohatoto gide hoya mahaina ꞌausalana ꞌalelewane taudi Yehoba ꞌiꞌabiꞌabihetedi ꞌoidiya, ta wete taudi nata sihesilae hataya ꞌoidiya.

Taudi tohesilae ꞌoidiya mahainaina ꞌana lotohona tuwa gide toꞌamasa mwahuluna, ma hesi taudi Yehoba ꞌiꞌabihetediya mahainaina ꞌana lotohona tuwa gide yawasi ꞌausalana mahaina gide. Hisa tomota sowasowadi paihowa bewa? Geya baibaiwana.

Ma tauma geya gide tolohatoto ꞌaboꞌabowao, taudi ꞌidi wasawasa tuwa weyahina silolohatoto, ma hesi tauma maꞌama hemisa, gide Yehoba ꞌiloinemaiya, ꞌoinega tauna matana Keliso tetelina ꞌagwaegwaene moisa.
